recognize_zh: 淋巴結內大型多形性、類 Hodgkin 的細胞成片出現，背景為富含淋巴球與組織球的多形性浸潤並有纖維化。免疫染色顯示大細胞 B 細胞標記強陽性、另有膜狀加 Golgi 點狀染色的標記，還有一個標記幾乎陰性；這種介於 cHL 與 DLBCL 之間的表現型，提示灰區淋巴瘤（gray zone lymphoma）。
features: Diffuse effacement of the node by a polymorphous infiltrate with interstitial fibrosis/collagen bands (lymphomatoid granulomatosis-like cytoarchitecture at low power)
Sheets and clusters of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, lobulated nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including Hodgkin-like forms
Background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and fibrinoid/necrotic material
Large cells strongly positive with a membranous marker and a strong nuclear marker (B-cell program retained; markers unlabeled)
Large cells show membranous plus Golgi/dot staining for a marker (CD15/CD30 pattern), while another stain is nearly negative apart from rare cells
A membranous stain decorates background small cells with large cells unstained (CD45-variable/T-cell pattern)
describe_en: Lymph node shows diffuse architectural effacement by a polymorphous infiltrate with bands of fibrosis. At high power there are sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular to multilobated nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells, set in a background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and fibrinoid debris. Immunohistochemical stains (markers not labeled in the images) show strong membranous and strong nuclear staining of the large cells, indicating a preserved B-cell program, together with membranous and Golgi-pattern staining in a subset, near-absent staining for another marker, and staining of background small cells sparing the large cells. The combination of Hodgkin-like morphology with strong B-cell marker expression and uniform CD15 with weak CD30 (per case data) is consistent with B-cell lymphoma, unclassifiable, with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma spectrum).

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (lymphocyte-depleted or syncytial nodular sclerosis)
ddx.vs: cHL HRS cells are CD30 strong, CD45-negative and show weak PAX5 with loss of CD20/OCT2/BOB1, whereas here the large cells retain a strong B-cell program and CD30 is weak to negative.
DLBCL is usually a monomorphic sheet of CD45+ large B cells without Hodgkin-like cells, CD15 expression or a rich lymphohistiocytic background.
THRLBCL has scattered single large B cells (fewer than 10%) that are CD15/CD30-negative, not sheets of pleomorphic cells.
These show angiocentric necrosis with numerous EBER-positive large B cells, so EBER ISH is needed to exclude them.
